acme: Akmē: point. The acme of the career: the CEO’s office.
Acme sounds like “acne”: the pimple at its peak. (Crude but sticks.)
affable: Ad + fari: easy to speak to. An affable receptionist.
Affable: the neighbour who chats over the fence.
affluent: Ad + fluere: flowing to you: money flows in. An affluent suburb.
Affluent: swimming pool and two cars.
bleak: Bleak: pale, colourless. A bleak winter moor.
A bleak future: no hope in sight.
candid: Candidus: shining white: pure honesty. A candid photo is unposed.
censor: Censor: cuts content. The film was censored.
Censor’s red pen blackens the page.
demean: De + mean: make low. A demeaning job: you’re treated as inferior.
Demean yourself: act beneath your dignity.
demure: Mûr: mature, grave. A demure girl lowers her eyes.
dog: Dog: follow persistently. Dogged by bad luck.
A dog at your heels: you can’t shake off the scandal.
dupe: Dupe: a fool: a dupe is tricked. Don’t be duped by the ad.
Dupe = huppe (hoopoe) bird, a silly bird in French lore.
embroiled: Embrouiller: to muddle. Embroiled in a legal fight.
err: Errare: wander. To err is human.
Err on the side of caution: make a mistake in the safer direction.
erratic: Errare: wander. An erratic driver swerves.
hound: Hound dog chases the fox. Reporters hound the star.
Hounded by creditors: they follow you everywhere.
indict: In + dicere: declare against: formally charge. Pronounced “in-DITE”.
Indict: the grand jury names you as accused.
indigenous: Indu + genus: born within. Indigenous plants.
indignant: In + dignus: affronted dignity. Indignant at the insult.
inflammatory: Flamma: flame. Inflammatory speech sets crowds ablaze.
Inflammatory tweet: pours petrol on a debate.
insolvent: In + solvere: can’t pay. An insolvent company goes bust.
Insolvent: the bank account hits zero.
inundate: Unda: wave. Inundated with calls: a flood.
mesmerize: Franz Mesmer, hypnotist in Paris, 1780s. The magician mesmerized the crowd.
Mesmerized by the flames of the fire: can’t look away.
miser: Miser: wretched. A miser counts gold at night.
Scrooge: the miser who hates Christmas.
peruse: Per + use: use thoroughly. Peruse the contract before signing.
pine: Pine: to ache for. Pining for a lost love.
Pine also a tree: but as a verb, to long for: “pining for the fjords”.
pinnacle: Pinna: feather/wing: top turret. The pinnacle of success.
Pinnacle: a spire on a cathedral.
profuse: Pro + fundere: pour forth. Profuse apologies.
remiss: Re + mittere: let go. Remiss = careless about duty.
Remiss: you forgot to lock the door.
retiring: Retire: withdraw. A retiring personality prefers the corner.
Retiring: shy, never speaks at parties.
screed: Screed: long strip. A screed of angry email.
Screed: a rant that goes on for pages.
serendipity: Serendipity: finding £20 in an old coat.
slapdash: Slap + dash: done quickly. A slapdash paint job.
Slapdash essay: written in ten minutes.
spendthrift: Spends thrift (savings). A spendthrift blows his paycheque.
stipend: Stips + pendere: weigh coins. A grad stipend.
summit: Summus: highest. The summit of Mont Blanc; G7 summit.
Summit = top of the mountain, or top-level meeting.
telling: Telling: it tells you something. A telling detail.
Telling silence: says more than words.
telltale: Tell-tale: tells on you. Telltale crumbs on his shirt.
Telltale signs of lying: a twitch.
tender: Tendere: stretch out. Tender your resignation: hand it over.
Tender: a formal bid for a contract.
thoroughgoing: Thorough + going: leaving nothing out. A thoroughgoing reform.
thrifty: Thrift: to thrive by saving. Thrifty shoppers.
tirade: Tirer: pull out lines. Cyrano’s tirade: a long speech.
Tirade: a coach yelling at the team.
underwrite: Write your name under the risk: you guarantee it. Banks underwrite the share offering.
Underwrite: back a project with money.
unnerve: Un + nerve: remove courage. The long silence unnerved him.
variance: Vary: difference. At variance with the facts.
Variance: how much the numbers differ.
vindictive: Vindictive: keeps score of every insult.
voracious: Vorare: devour. A voracious reader devours novels.
zenith: Zenith: the point directly overhead. The sun at its zenith.
